description: A Flutter widget class for a payment method selection bottom sheet, providing quick access to payment apps via deep links and handling app not installed scenarios.

classes.name: PaymentMethodSheet
classes.description: A stateless widget that displays a bottom sheet with payment options such as Paytm, Google Pay, PhonePe, and Cash.

methods.name: _buildPaymentOption
methods.description: Builds a ListTile widget for a payment option with icon, name, color, and tap handler.

methods.name: _launchPaymentApp
methods.description: Attempts to launch a payment app via deep link; shows a snackbar if the app is not installed.
